svg.aria-label: Scatter plot: trains that were delayed in May were also delayed in June.
svg.text: Each dot is one train. Further right: the more delay it had in May.
Further up: the more delay the same train had in June.
Each dot = one train (random sample of 1,600 out of 41,138) · Data: Deutsche Bahn timetable data (IRIS) · May–June 2026
